import hashlib, json
base = json.dumps({'requests': 3, 'tokens': 120}, sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')
k1 = 'shared/raw/demo.json'
k2 = 'students/2410311308/raw/demo.json'
print('P1 same bytes -> two keys')
print('  key A:', k1, hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest())
print('  key B:', k2, hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest())
indented = json.dumps({'requests': 3, 'tokens': 120}, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode('utf-8')
print('P2 indent only')
print('  compact sha256:', hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest())
print('  indented sha256:', hashlib.sha256(indented).hexdigest())
print('  bytes equal:', base == indented, '| parsed values equal:', json.loads(base) == json.loads(indented))
changed = json.dumps({'requests': 4, 'tokens': 120}, sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')
print('P3 one number changed 3->4')
print('  before sha256:', hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest())
print('  after  sha256:', hashlib.sha256(changed).hexdigest())
